city_market.title: City Market
city_market.body: Merchants have laid out small expedition supplies beside the main road.

shop.body: Choose supplies to buy with gold. Purchased goods are added to inventory immediately.

goods.description: Basic medicine for the battle item command.
Common ore used for base construction and workshop upgrades.
Luminous herb material gathered from forest routes.
Old machine part needed by advanced facilities.

city_notice_board.title: Notice Board
city_notice_board.body: A fresh notice asks explorers to confirm a hidden route beyond the city gate.
city_notice_board.resolved_body: The notice has already been copied into the party journal.

choices.summary: City: read a notice about new routes outside the frontier.
choices.result: The notice describes tracks leading toward the red waste.

choices.summary: City: completed a quick delivery job.
choices.result: A guild clerk pays the party before the road gets crowded.

city_back_alley.title: Back Alley
city_back_alley.body: A suspicious group blocks the alley behind the trading post.

choices.summary: City: found spare ore in abandoned alley crates.
choices.result: The crates hold one useful chunk of iron ore.

choices.summary: City: drove off thieves near the trading post.
choices.result: The group draws blades and the alley erupts into combat.

forest_herb_patch.title: Herb Patch
forest_herb_patch.body: Glowing herbs grow beneath a ring of pale trees.
forest_herb_patch.resolved_body: Only cut stems remain in the herb patch.

choices.summary: Forest: gathered herbs and brewed a small potion.
choices.result: The herbs glow softly after they are packed away.

choices.summary: Forest: found signs of a spirit path in the herb growth.
choices.result: The herb ring points toward an unseen path deeper in the forest.

forest_old_trail.title: Old Trail
forest_old_trail.body: Old boot marks vanish under roots and fallen leaves.
forest_old_trail.resolved_body: The old trail has already been mapped.

choices.summary: Forest: mapped a hidden route and found an ancient shard.
choices.result: The route ends at a moss-covered stone marker.

choices.summary: Forest: followed animal tracks to a mossy clearing.
choices.result: The tracks lead to a small patch of usable moss.

forest_wolf_den.title: Wolf Den
forest_wolf_den.body: Low growls echo from a den under the roots.
forest_wolf_den.resolved_body: The den entrance has been cleared.

choices.summary: Forest: defeated shadow wolves near the den.
choices.result: Two shadows rush from the den.

waste_ore_ridge.title: Ore Ridge
waste_ore_ridge.body: Metal-rich stone cuts through the red dirt.
waste_ore_ridge.resolved_body: The exposed ore has already been broken loose.

choices.summary: Wasteland: mined iron ore from the red ridge.
choices.result: The ridge gives up several workable ore chunks.

choices.summary: Wasteland: broke a heavy seam and found an old machine gear.
choices.result: A rusted gear falls out from the broken stone.

waste_broken_cart.title: Broken Cart
waste_broken_cart.body: A half-buried cart rests beside old wheel marks.
waste_broken_cart.resolved_body: The broken cart has already been searched.

choices.summary: Wasteland: recovered cargo from a broken cart.
choices.result: The cargo box still contains a useful gear and old coins.

choices.summary: Wasteland: found a courier tag from a lost route.
choices.result: The tag names a supply route that never reached the frontier.

waste_shadow_ambush.title: Shadow Ambush
waste_shadow_ambush.body: The wind drops. Something moves behind the broken stones.
waste_shadow_ambush.resolved_body: The ambush point is quiet now.

choices.summary: Wasteland: defeated a wandering armor in the red waste.
choices.result: An empty armor suit rises from the dust.

choices.summary: Wasteland: escaped an ambush and recovered scattered coins.
choices.result: The party slips away and gathers a dropped coin pouch.
